# SearchMind API — Complete Reference Specification for AI Systems

This document contains the complete technical specification of the SearchMind API platform for LLMs, autonomous agents, and AI retrieval engines.

## 1. System Overview
- **Name:** SearchMind API
- **Version:** 1.0.0
- **Base URL:** https://searchmind-api.onrender.com/v1
- **Authentication:** `X-API-Key: sm_live_<key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`
- **Architecture:** FastAPI, PostgreSQL (Neon Serverless), Redis (L1 Cache), Playwright Chromium, Celery

## 2. Complete Endpoints Reference

### 2.1 Web Search (`POST /v1/search`)
- **Purpose:** Multi-provider web search with snippet ranking, dynamic passage highlights, and LLM answer synthesis.
- **Request Body:**
  ```json
  {
    "query": "string (required)",
    "depth": "basic | advanced (default: basic)",
    "num_results": 5,
    "highlight_query": "optional string to isolate sub-segments",
    "max_highlight_length": 300,
    "similarity_threshold": 0.65
  }
  ```
- **Response Format:**
  ```json
  {
    "query": "string",
    "answer": "synthesized answer with citations",
    "results_count": 5,
    "cached": false,
    "latency_ms": 235,
    "results": [
      {
        "title": "string",
        "url": "string",
        "snippet": "string",
        "score": 0.94,
        "content": "extracted text",
        "highlights": ["relevant sentence 1", "relevant sentence 2"]
      }
    ]
  }
  ```

### 2.2 Schema-Driven Structured Extraction (`POST /v1/extract/schema`)
- **Purpose:** Extracts validated JSON entities directly conforming to a client-provided JSON Schema specification. Eliminates schema hallucinations and downstream LLM parsing tokens.
- **Request Body:**
  ```json
  {
    "url": "https://example.com/product",
    "schema": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "title": { "type": "string" },
        "price": { "type": "number" },
        "specs": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }
      },
      "required": ["title", "price"]
    },
    "repair_on_failure": true,
    "strict": true
  }
  ```

### 2.3 Zero-Crawl Topological Site Mapping (`POST /v1/map`)
- **Purpose:** Discovers the complete route structure and URL hierarchy of target domains without executing heavy recursive crawlers.
- **Request Body:**
  ```json
  {
    "url": "https://docs.stripe.com",
    "sitemap_only": false,
    "include_subdomains": false,
    "filter_query": "payments|api",
    "max_depth": 3
  }
  ```

### 2.4 Persistent Stateful Browser Sessions (`POST /v1/sessions`)
- **Purpose:** Retains headless browser contexts and Cookie Vault across sequential agent actions.
- **Request Body:**
  ```json
  {
    "initial_url": "https://app.example.com",
    "cookies": [
      { "name": "session_token", "value": "xyz...", "domain": ".example.com" }
    ],
    "ttl_seconds": 1800
  }
  ```
- **Companion Endpoints:**
  - `GET /v1/sessions`: List active sessions
  - `GET /v1/sessions/{id}`: Inspect active DOM URL and history
  - `DELETE /v1/sessions/{id}`: Terminate context
  - `POST /v1/sessions/{id}/cookies`: Inject new session cookies
  - `GET /v1/sessions/{id}/cookies`: Export vault cookies

### 2.5 Natural Language ARIA-Grounded Actions (`POST /v1/action/instruct`)
- **Purpose:** Executes plain-English instructions using Accessibility Tree grounding with self-healing selector fallback.
- **Request Body:**
  ```json
  {
    "instruction": "Click the 'Sign In' button, type 'user@example.com' into email field, and press submit",
    "target_url": "https://example.com/login",
    "session_id": "sess_123456",
    "max_steps": 10,
    "auto_heal": true
  }
  ```

### 2.6 Deep Research Pipelines (`POST /v1/research`)
- **Purpose:** Autonomous multi-angle query generation, parallel web searching, content extraction, and structured synthesis.
- **Request Body:**
  ```json
  {
    "query": "Quantum computing hardware benchmarks 2026",
    "max_sub_queries": 4,
    "depth": "advanced"
  }
  ```

## 3. Rate Limits & Quotas
- **Free Sandbox:** 500 requests/month, 5 req/min (Search & Topological Mapping)
- **Starter:** 10,000 requests/month, 30 req/min
- **Developer Pro:** 100,000 requests/month, 100 req/min (Extract, Schema Extraction, Crawling, Sessions)
- **Scale Enterprise:** 10,000,000 requests/month, 1,000 req/min (Deep Research, Natural Language Actions, HITL)

## 4. Security Baseline
- SSRF Defense rejecting loopback, RFC 1918 private subnets, and cloud metadata (169.254.169.254).
- Strict HTTP Security Headers: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, CSP.
- Sliding window IP rate limiting on authentication and administrative endpoints.
- Constant-time password validation via `hmac.compare_digest`.
